# README artwork and screenshot

The cover is original THE MARGIN artwork created for Valkenburgh Margin in October 2026. It is decorative, not an application screenshot.

The unchanged WebP screenshot is copied from [the portfolio evidence source](https://github.com/vmargin/vmargin.github.io/blob/dd7e03f724c08c83154d9dbab8df7d9e302a7194/public/images/projects/cash-g-web-v2-dashboard.webp). It shows CASH-G Web v2 running in its local synthetic-data H2 demo. It does not prove hosted availability, a current end-to-end test, real adoption, or business results.

See [portfolio evidence context](https://github.com/vmargin/vmargin.github.io/blob/dd7e03f724c08c83154d9dbab8df7d9e302a7194/docs/evidence-sources.md).
